body.p: After (owner priority 1). Starts with 's "Not done": a library module's context value type, fn:string-length and fn:normalize-space atomizing an explicit argument, casts to xs:QName with the namespaces of an enclosing direct constructor, is-id of list and union ID types (an additive way, since tree.h is frozen), use-xsi-schema-location; then the largest clusters of fresh whole runs (XP40 55 failed and 32 wrong-error passes, XQ40 191 and 53), skipping those keeps. Estimates what the optional staticTyping feature would take (XQuery 4.0, the appendix on static typing; 104 XQ40 and 48 XP40 cases) without implementing it. Files: the evaluator, the XPath and XQuery lowering and static analysis, the function library and the validator parts the fixes touch. Verification as says; the XP40 and XQ40 sections of docs/CONFORMANCE.md regenerated from whole runs of the final code. Done 2026-10-20 (): 's list but use-xsi-schema-location (no failing case), nested constructors' namespaces, named item type checks, variable cycles at run time, XSLT's QName casts and comparisons; XP40 32,716 to 32,731 passed (55 to 40 failed), XQ40 46,017 to 46,070 (191 to 138), none lost; static typing estimated, not implemented. CONFORMANCE.md not regenerated (another packet's uncommitted changes). Open: 's "Not done".
